gaps: binge and since are stubs awaiting a local sync mirror with season-episode listings and historical snapshots.

novel_features.name: stats
novel_features.description: Roll up your watched history into episodes, estimated hours, and your most-watched shows — straight from /user/{user_id}/stats.
novel_features.rationale: The TV Time mobile app shows this on a profile screen; no public tool exposes it for scripting or dashboards.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pipe your watch totals into a dashboard, a homepage stat widget, or a year-in-review post.

novel_features.name: agenda
novel_features.description: See what airs today or in the next N days for the shows you follow.
novel_features.rationale: TV Time has a calendar in the app but no good way to surface 'what airs this week' to other tools.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Drives a daily 'what's new' email, a Raycast widget, or a homepage 'on tonight' block.

novel_features.name: next
novel_features.description: Pick the single best next episode to watch across all your in-progress shows.
novel_features.rationale: The to-watch queue is a flat list; deciding 'one thing to watch now' is its own decision.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Removes the choose-what-to-watch tax. Wire it into a 'one button to start tonight's show' flow.

novel_features.name: backlog
novel_features.description: Rank the shows you follow by how many unwatched episodes are piling up.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregating the to-watch queue by show is a one-line script people keep rewriting.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Tells you which shows are slipping. Useful for 'shows I should drop' or 'shows to catch up on this weekend'.

novel_features.name: binge
novel_features.description: (stub) Bulk-mark a whole season or show as watched in one command. Not yet wired — requires a season-episode listing from a sync mirror that isn't implemented yet.
novel_features.rationale: TV Time's app makes you tap each episode; bulk-mark is the #1 quality-of-life request.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Stubbed for now so the shape is visible; intent is to ship once the sync mirror lands.

novel_features.name: since
novel_features.description: (stub) Show what changed in your queue since a point in time. Not yet wired — requires a local sync mirror with historical snapshots that isn't implemented yet.
novel_features.rationale: After time away you want a diff, not the whole queue.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Stubbed for now; intent is to ship once the sync mirror lands.
